name: ork-codex
description: Portable OrchestKit workflows for Codex: brainstorm, explore, assess, verify, and review pull requests.

interface.longDescription: A small, Codex-native OrchestKit pack for deliberate planning, codebase exploration, assessment, verification, and pull-request review. It uses Codex skills and subagents without Claude-only commands or hooks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ork-brainstorm to compare approaches before I implement a change.
